message:
Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:keydown` to listen to the keydown event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onkeydown` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:input` to listen to the input event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `oninput` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

`nodes` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
